description: This PHP source file defines the class 'CaseEventsHook', which appears to be a hook or event handler for tracking changes in 'Case' records within a CRM system. It compares old and new bean data to generate change events for fields like priority, status, assigned user, and type, and saves these events.

classes.name: CaseEventsHook
classes.description: A class that tracks changes to a case record and generates corresponding event entries.

methods.name: compareBeans
methods.description: Compares the old and new case beans to detect changes in specific fields and returns event objects for each change.

methods.name: saveUpdate
methods.description: Handles the save/update operation for a case bean, retrieving the previous state and generating change events as needed.
